name: Calumet City
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Calumet City, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Calumet City, IL: the City Hall tree lighting with a holiday pop-up shop and the park district's free Christmas Extravaganza.
lede: Calumet City kicks off Christmas with a tree lighting in front of City Hall on Pulaski Road, hosted by the mayor and City Council. The Calumet Memorial Park District adds a free Christmas Extravaganza at its Sandridge building on Oglesby Avenue.
celebrates: In Calumet City, the season centers on the annual tree lighting ceremony at City Hall, 204 Pulaski Road, hosted by Mayor Thaddeus M. Jones and the City Council. In 2023 the Lansing Journal described live music, food trucks, games, light displays and heated tents along Pulaski Road, with Santa arriving on a sleigh and the Grinch stopping by. The Calumet Memorial Park District throws a Christmas Extravaganza at its Sandridge building on Oglesby Avenue with bumper cars and bounce houses. The public library sets up a Christmas Station with gift wrapping, ornament making and letters to Santa, and Santa takes photo visits at River Oaks Center.
lastyear: The city's October 2025 newsletter planned the tree lighting ceremony for Friday, December 5, 2025, from 5 to 8 pm at City Hall. The park district's CMPD Christmas Around the World Extravaganza was planned for Saturday, December 6, 2025, from noon to 6 pm at the Sandridge Fitness Center, with bumper cars, a giant walk-in photo booth, a Winter Wonderland Dash obstacle course, Christmas bounce houses and a Christmas KindlMarket of local vendors. In January 2026, ABC7 reported that city leaders surprised a local family with a Christmas in January, with toys and gifts under the tree.
facts: Calumet City was founded in 1893 as West Hammond, named because it sits on the west side of the state line from Hammond, Indiana. Residents voted in 1923 to change the name to Calumet City, and locals still call it Cal City. At the 2023 tree lighting, Santa rolled in on his sleigh, the Saint Sabina Youth Choir of Chicago sang Joy to the World and This Christmas, and families lined up to play video games inside mobile game trucks parked on Pulaski Road.
trains: Pace runs bus routes that connect Calumet City with towns across the Southland. For a real train ride, the South Shore Line stops at Hegewisch station in Chicago, just north of town. It is the last Illinois stop heading out, with trains west to Millennium Station downtown and east to Hammond, Gary, Michigan City and South Bend in Indiana. The current station opened on June 2, 1992. For a bigger train day, the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry has a giant model railroad, and the Illinois Railway Museum in Union runs a Christmas train.

traditions: The mayor and City Council light the city Christmas tree in front of City Hall on Pulaski Road.
In 2023 Mayor Thaddeus M. Jones led the crowd in a countdown before the tree and decorations lit up.
At the 2023 ceremony Santa arrived on his sleigh and spent the evening taking pictures with families.
The Calumet Memorial Park District fills its Sandridge building on Oglesby Avenue with bumper cars, bounce houses and holiday crafts.
The Calumet City Public Library sets up gift wrapping, ornament making, cookie decorating and letters to Santa before Christmas.
Santa takes photo visits at River Oaks Center, with online reservations and walk ups welcome.
kidfact: Calumet City has two water towers painted like giant smiley faces. One stands on Ring Road near River Oaks Center and the other on State Street near Interstate 94.
faq: Where is the Calumet City tree lighting?

The city holds its tree lighting ceremony at City Hall, 204 Pulaski Road, hosted by Mayor Thaddeus M. Jones and the City Council, with the official lighting at 6 pm. In 2023 the Lansing Journal described live music, food trucks, games, light displays and heated tents set up along Pulaski Road between Lincoln and Wentworth Avenues.
What is the CMPD Christmas Extravaganza?

It is the Calumet Memorial Park District's holiday party in its Sandridge building at 600 Oglesby Avenue. Listings include bumper cars, bounce houses, crafts and holiday movies, and the 2025 edition was planned with a giant walk-in photo booth, a Winter Wonderland Dash obstacle course and a Christmas KindlMarket of local vendors.
Where can kids see Santa in Calumet City?

Santa came to the city tree lighting in 2023, arriving on a sleigh to take pictures with families. He also takes photo visits at River Oaks Center, 96 River Oaks Center Drive, in the weeks before Christmas. The mall's Santa set takes online reservations in 15 minute time slots, and walk ups are welcome until closing.
Is Calumet City in Illinois or Indiana?

Calumet City is in Illinois, in Cook County's Thornton Township. It sits right on the state line, and Hammond, Indiana, borders it to the east, which is why the town was first called West Hammond when it was founded in 1893. Events in Hammond and Munster are in Indiana, not Calumet City.
Can we get to Calumet City by train?

Pace runs bus routes that connect Calumet City with towns across the Southland. For a train ride, the South Shore Line stops at Hegewisch station in Chicago, just north of town, with trains to Millennium Station downtown and east to Hammond, Gary and South Bend in Indiana. Fares at Hegewisch follow Metra's fare structure.
